verdict.rationale: Reflect documents export to open formats (Markdown, HTML) and import from Markdown, plus an API for appending/reading note data, and this is corroborated independently by the founder confirming export to markdown/HTML anytime as an anti-lock-in measure. Missing for 10: no evidence of full-archive/bulk export tooling, no JSON export format explicitly documented (only import supports JSON via Roam), and no independent audit of export fidelity.
